Preserve full uncropped circle within a white square, dark burgundy outer ring, ochre-gold inner ring, subtle pale cream paper interior, generous margins, warm richly detailed hand-painted botanical illustration. A single large brown wooden bowl at bottom center, small matching wooden scoop at lower LEFT. Preserve completely empty cream upper 40% for editor-added lettering. Side botanical/spice accents stay in lower half to lower 60%. Replace the salt crystals and fenugreek seeds and their plants entirely with this specifically requested dry spice mixture; the bowl, scoop and small scatter in front contain the same mixture. items.name: Przyprawa do tacos
items.detail: Russet-red dry taco seasoning with cumin, chili, paprika, garlic, oregano and small pepper specks. Side accents: red chili pods, cumin seeds, garlic cloves and oregano. No tacos, shells, tortillas, meat or vegetables arranged as a meal.

items.name: Przyprawa do fajitas
items.detail: Dry paprika-orange seasoning with garlic and onion granules, cumin, oregano and lime zest flecks. Side accents: red and green sweet peppers, half a green lime, onion and a small cumin-seed scatter. Bowl and scoop hold seasoning only, no cooked fajitas.

items.name: Przyprawa chili con carne
items.detail: Deep brick-red ground chili and cumin blend with paprika, oregano, garlic and black pepper. Side accents: dried ancho-like red-brown chili pods, cumin, oregano and garlic. No beans, stew, meat or prepared chili dish.

items.name: Przyprawa mole
items.detail: Dry fine dark chocolate-brown spice mix with ground dried ancho/pasilla chili, cocoa, cinnamon and sesame flecks. Side accents: cacao pod and beans, dark wrinkled dried chili peppers, cinnamon sticks and pale sesame seeds. No chocolate bar, liquid sauce or cooked food.

items.name: Przyprawa meksykańska
items.detail: Dry bright rusty-orange regional blend with chili, paprika, coriander, cumin, garlic and oregano flecks. Side accents: different red chili pods, coriander leaves and seeds, cumin and garlic. Visibly a mixed dry seasoning, no salsa, cactus or flag.

items.name: Przyprawa tex-mex
items.detail: Coarse reddish-tan dry seasoning with smoked paprika, chili, cumin, onion and garlic granules and black pepper specks. Side accents: dried red chili, paprika pepper, onion, garlic and cumin seeds. No barbecue dish, tacos or packaging.

items.name: Przyprawa chimichurri
items.detail: Dry coarse green herbal blend of parsley and oregano with garlic granules and a scattering of red chili flakes. Side accents: large flat parsley leaves, oregano sprigs, garlic cloves and a slender red chili. No oil, wet sauce or meat.

items.name: Gremolata suszona
items.detail: Dry vibrant green and lemon-yellow blend of chopped parsley, fine dried lemon zest and garlic granules. Side accents: flat parsley, a cut yellow lemon and narrow curls of lemon peel, garlic cloves. No oil or liquid, dominant green-gold seasoning without red chili.

items.name: Przyprawa shawarma
items.detail: Fine cinnamon-brown and golden dry blend of cumin, coriander, paprika, cardamom, turmeric, cinnamon and pepper. Side accents: cumin and coriander seeds, green cardamom pods, a cinnamon stick and turmeric root. No wrap, rotisserie or meat.

items.name: Przyprawa kebab
items.detail: Warm red-brown dry spice mix of paprika, cumin, coriander, garlic, black pepper and oregano. Side accents: red paprika pepper, cumin and coriander seeds, garlic and oregano. No skewers, meat, bread or cooked dish.

items.name: Przyprawa gyros
items.detail: Dry tan-green seasoning dominated by oregano, garlic, onion, thyme and paprika specks. Side accents: broad oregano leaves, thyme, garlic and a small onion. No gyro sandwich, pita or cooked meat.

items.name: Przyprawa shoarma
items.detail: Distinctive warm ochre-brown ground dry blend of cumin, coriander, turmeric, paprika, cinnamon, clove and black pepper. Side accents: turmeric root, cumin seeds, split nutmeg and dark cloves with a little coriander foliage. No meat, wraps or sauce.

items.name: Przyprawa kofta
items.detail: Warm earthy tan-brown dry seasoning with cumin, coriander, black pepper, cinnamon and dried parsley flakes. Side accents: coriander seeds, cumin seeds, cinnamon sticks and flat parsley. No meatballs, skewers or cooked food.

items.name: Przyprawa falafel
items.detail: Green-tan dry blend of cumin, coriander, garlic, parsley and black pepper. Side accents: abundant parsley and coriander leaves, cumin and coriander seeds, garlic. Bowl contains only dry herbs and spice granules, no chickpeas, falafel balls or tahini.

items.name: Przyprawa satay
items.detail: Dry golden ochre blend of turmeric, coriander, cumin, ginger, garlic and chili flecks. Side accents: turmeric and ginger roots, coriander seeds, garlic and a red chili. Only dry spice powder; no peanut sauce, liquid or skewers.

ingredient_note: Representative visual compositions for dried seasoning; generic regional blends are artistic choices, not an assertion of a single canonical recipe.
